mentions.name: Warenkorb+
mentions.description: A Chrome and Firefox browser extension that simplifies transferring grocery items from Cookidoo to Knuspr, automating the weekly workflow of copying, pasting, and sorting the grocery page for each item.
mentions.problem: Weekly grocery ordering required manually copying, pasting, and sorting the grocery page for each item.
mentions.audience: The author's own weekly grocery purchasing workflow
mentions.source_excerpt:
Warenkorb+ (German for „shopping cart“): https://github.com/Lars147/warenkorb_plus

A browser extension (Chrome & Firefox) for simplifying my online grocery purchase workflow from Cookidoo to Knuspr.

I was tired of my weekly workflow of copying, pasting & sorting the grocery page for each item.
